scientific_integrity: The analytic gradient/entropy identity, equilibrium census, and strict LaSalle argument establish the all-finite-state convergence theorem. Hyperbolicity and basin barrier proved for the same model; finite verifier checks only examples. No independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Only the deterministic homogeneous complete-interaction mean-field incremental voter ODE; the basin test is sufficient rather than complete, convergence constants are trajectory-dependent, and no finite-population transition claims follow.
title: Entropy-dissipation trichotomy and an explicit basin barrier for the incremental voter model
